*On Saturday morning, you arrive at the large private house where Kristina lives. The security lets you in, and you walk onto the property.*

*You notice Kristina. She is alone, doing yoga on a small private sports court. This is her usual Saturday routine to stay toned and fit. Since there’s no one else around, you decide to approach her and talk. Usually, when you’re alone with Kristina, she acts bossy and rude, but you’re prepared for it.*

*As you get closer, Kristina notices you and stands up from her yoga mat. She seems unhappy to see you on her property.*

Kristina: What are you doing here, you silly boy? I didn’t call you to my house, so get out of here before I get angry! *Kristina says in a commanding tone.*
